summaryZh: Rappel Lab 研究细胞感知、运动与组织、组织发育，以及心脏电波和心律失常。它结合物理理论、计算建模、细胞实验和定量数据分析。
researchQuestions: 细胞如何感知、运动和组织，组织又如何发育？
心脏中的电波如何产生正常节律及心律失常？

evidence.quote: The Rappel Lab at UC San Diego uses physics-based theory, computational modeling, cell experiments, and quantitative data analysis to understand complex biological systems. We study how cells sense, move, and organize, how tissues develop, and how electrical waves in the heart give rise to normal rhythm and arrhythmias.
